thread:
sarah (AE): Quick sync — NovaHealth POC scope. Need to align on top 3 user journeys, endpoints, and success metrics so we can finalize pricing & security asks. Can we lock a 6-week timeline?

mike (SalesEng): SG. Quick Q: primary success driver = latency or output quality?

sarah (AE): They care about real-time triage replies for support agents (latency) but also hallucination reduction for clinical guidance (quality). Both matter.

olivia (CSE): Proposed prioritization: 1) Agent-assist reply generation (low latency, fallback to smaller model) 2) Document summarization for patient notes (throughput) 3) Similarity search/embeddings for past cases (accuracy). Thoughts? :thinking_face:  

sam (NovaHealth Eng): That matches internal ranking. If we have to cut scope, start with agent-assist + embeddings. Summaries can be batch.

mike (SalesEng): OK. For agent-assist let's propose endpoints + sample prompts and evals: 
- Endpoint 1: `/v1/redwood/generate` for live responses (streaming allowed)
- Endpoint 2: `/v1/redwood/embeddings` for vector lookup

Sample prompt (agent-assist):
```
The patient has symptoms: fever, cough, history of asthma. Provide a concise suggested reply for the support agent (<= 2 sentences), include any safety flags.
```
Evaluation metrics: p95 latency < 250ms, accuracy/hallucination rate < 3% on curated eval set, token cost < $0.10 per session (approx).

olivia (CSE): Adding rollout policy: start with canary (5% traffic) on hosted -> if hallucination > threshold, fallback to a smaller but more conservative model. Also enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts (saves tokens).

sarah (AE): Pricing question from procurement: Can we price a month-limited POC with usage cap and a flat bench fee for Dedicated if they want isolation?

mike (SalesEng): Yes — suggest: hosted POC at usage-based rate with a $2k/month cap + optional Dedicated trial at a discounted fixed rate (e.g., $6k/mo) for 4 weeks. I'll draft numbers.

sam (NovaHealth Eng): Security checklist: SSO (SAML), SOC2, data residency in us-east-1, and an IR playbook. Need answers by Tue.

security-bot: NovaHealth security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.app/security/novahealth-questionnaire — current status: 12/34 answered. Please @olivia for technical Qs and @mike for commercial Qs.

olivia (CSE): I'll take the technical bits. Quick note: for data residency we can host control plane in their VPC (Private) or ensure region pinning on Hosted. Both valid.

mike (SalesEng): Action items: 
- @mike: send POC pricing sheet + contract template by EOD Fri
- @olivia: complete remaining security answers and propose SSO runbook by Mon
- @sarah: confirm internal eval set (we need 50 prompts + ground truth) from NovaHealth by Wed
- @sam: confirm whether agent UI will stream partial tokens or wait for full response (streaming affects latency SLOs)

sam (NovaHealth Eng): We'll stream partial tokens — streaming required. Also confirm whether you support function/tool calling (we want to call an internal triage API).

mike (SalesEng): Yes, Redwood supports function/tool calling; include example: 
```
POST /v1/redwood/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Body: {
  "model": "redwood-2.0",
  "stream": true,
  "tools": ["triage_api"],
  "prompt": "..."
}
```

olivia (CSE): For evals — provide a mixed set: 30 live-dialog prompts, 20 synthesis/summary prompts. We'll run A/B between a quantized faster variant and the full-precision model. Success = prefer faster variant 70% of time by cost/perf tradeoff with <=1% quality delta.

sarah (AE): Timeline draft: Week 0: contract + security signoff; Week 1: infra + test dataset ingestion; Weeks 2–4: live testing + iterative prompt tuning; Week 5: run evals + cost analysis; Week 6: wrap + decision. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: FYI — Dedicated trial requires ticket to infra with GPU SKU request. Lead time ~ 3 business days after approval.

sam (NovaHealth Eng): No other blockers from our side. We'll provide eval set by Wed COB.

mike (SalesEng): I'll draft a one-pager w/ endpoints, SLO targets, and pricing. Expect in ~2 hours. If anyone has additional must-have metrics, drop them here. :+1:

olivia (CSE): Add hallucination examples we should catch (3 cases) and a priority list for fallback behaviors. I'll upload to the questionnaire link.

sarah (AE): Great — let's reconvene Thu 11am PT for final sign-off. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
